snippet.title: BACK TO THE FUTURE - THE RIDE | IN VR - 2025
snippet.description:
WE'RE CELEBRATING THE 4OTH ANNIVERSARY OF BACK TO THE FUTURES ORIGINAL RELEASE, YOU CAN NOW GO BACK & RELIVE OR EXPERIENCE FOR THE FIRST TIME UNIVERSAL STUDIOS ORIGINAL BACK TO THE FUTURE - THE RIDE IN VR, REBUILT, REMODELED AND REDESIGNED FROM THE GROUND UP!

VISIT: https://backtothefuture-vr.com/ to subscribe for release details

EZImaginations has worked very hard developing, re-imagining and recreating the original & iconic "BACK TO THE FUTURE" the ride experience that sadly ended in 2007.

In celebration of the 40th anniversary we've given the "Institute of Future Technology" a facelift while maintaining the same sense of wonder that the original ride brought so many of us around the world whether we were children or adults. This VR experience is a resurrection of the past in true Back to the Future fashion for those whom experienced it while it existed & for those whom never had the pleasure.

As a special bonus we've also recreated the 2015 Hill Valley Square, staying as true to the original design as possible. Some things had to be relocated/rearranged given their placement in the movie didn't work with the scale of the Institute of Future Technology. So we decided to make Hill Valley it's own fictional area within what you would find in a real theme park. Think of it as "BACK TO THE FUTURE WORLD", except from your home. All the glimmer and imagination of the real deal with a few changes, and in some ways upgrades as everything has been recreated and modernized from the ground up.

We’d like to thank Bob Gale & Robert Zemeckis for creating a story that has forever impacted our lives & we thank the hundreds/thousands of film crew members that made the trilogy possible as well as the theme park attraction design teams at Universal Studios.

Almost 20 years after Universal Studios dismantled "BACK TO THE FUTURE" the ride forever, now it can live on not only through our memories & echoing through the space time continuum, but it can be re-visited & re-experienced in newly imagined ways through the wonders of Virtual Reality and visual effects animation of the modern age.

Branded logos and/or products mentioned are trademarks belonging to their respective owners.

THIS IS NOT AN OFFICIAL LICENSED PRODUCT OF UNIVERSAL STUDIOS, NBC UNIVERSAL HOLLYWOOD, COMCAST OR ANY SUBSIDIARIES. THIS IS A FAN BASED DEVELOPMENT VIRTUAL REALITY EXPERIENCE.
